help.title: Help Center
help.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Film Roulette
help.gettingStartedDesc: Film Roulette is a free, no-signup movie and TV show discovery platform. Just roll the dice and find your perfect watch for tonight.
help.gs1Desc: Hit the big "🎲 Roll the Dice!" button on the home page to get a random movie or TV show recommendation instantly.
help.gs2Desc: Click the ❤️ heart icon on any title card to save it to your Favourites list.
help.gs3Desc: Every title you roll is automatically saved to your History. Access it from the menu anytime.
help.feat1Desc: Our algorithm picks a random movie or TV series from thousands in the TMDB database, filtered by your preferences.
help.feat2Desc: Use the search bar in the header to find any specific movie or series by title.
help.feat3Desc: Every title card has a "Watch Trailer" button that loads the official YouTube trailer directly.
help.feat4Desc: Tap "Watch Now" to stream via our embedded player with automatic multi-server failover.
help.filt1Desc: Filter between Movies, TV Series, or All.
help.filt2Desc: Filter by genre — Action, Comedy, Drama, Sci-Fi, Crime, Animation, and more.
help.filt3Desc: Set a "From" and "To" year to discover classics or recent hits.
help.filt4Desc: Filter titles by their original language — English, Turkish, French, Korean, and more.
help.filt5Desc: Only see titles above a minimum TMDB score — great for finding quality picks.
help.pl1Desc: Our player embeds high-uptime streams from multiple providers. No account or registration needed.
help.pl2Desc: If a stream server is unreachable, the player automatically tests and switches to the next reliable alternative. You can also manually switch servers anytime.
help.pl3Desc: For TV series, easily select any season and episode to play directly with season breakdown.
help.acc1Desc: Film Roulette works completely without signup. Your data stays on your device.
help.acc2Desc: Your History, Favourites and watch progress are stored in your browser's local storage — not on any server.
help.acc3Desc: To reset everything, simply clear your browser's site data or local storage for filmroulette.vercel.app.
help.faq1A: Yes, 100% free. No subscription, no ads, no account required.
help.faq2A: Try switching the server using the "Next Server" or server buttons. Some titles or episodes may not be available on every single server.
help.faq3A: Yes! Full TV Series support is built in. You can choose specific seasons and episodes.
help.faq4A: Metadata is powered by The Movie Database (TMDB). Video streams are resolved through high-uptime embed providers.
help.faq5Q: How do I report a bug?
help.faq5A: Contact the developer via the app's download page or social media.
